SlopIsolate · free, in your browser

Remove the background from a video

Drop a short clip and SlopIsolate cuts out the person or object in every frame, on your device. Save it with a transparent background to put over another video.

Remove a video background

Watch the SlopIsolate tutorial: remove backgrounds in the browser
On YouTube, about two minutes.

How to do it

  1. Drop a short video clip (MP4 or WebM) on the page.
  2. Check the first frame: the subject is cut out and the edges are smoothed over time.
  3. Run the whole clip. Progress shows frame by frame.
  4. Save a WebM with a transparent background, or a ZIP of PNG frames where the browser cannot write transparent WebM.

Your files stay on this device: SlopIsolate runs in your browser, with no upload, no account and no watermark.

Questions

How long can the video be?

Short clips work best: every frame is processed on your device, so a few seconds to a minute is practical. The page tells you the limits before it starts.

What format is the result?

A WebM video with an alpha channel. Browsers that cannot write transparent WebM get a ZIP of PNG frames instead.

Is the video uploaded anywhere?

No. Decoding, cutting out and encoding all happen in your browser, and the clip never leaves your device.
